descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S22 Real phone with a wrong date or another time zone

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Today' on the timeline comes from the server clock, not the device's; a device with a wrong date, no clock set or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device. (UAT 3.8; TFA-92589 AC 7)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack only (never the store / TestFlight build, never dev): a native dev build pointed at the local Convex, or the phone's browser on the LAN Vite URL, with an @roundai.test account. One iPhone or Android set to yesterday's date, one set 1 day ahead, one in a different time zone, plus one correct device, all on …

When Finish a Nursing Home visit on the wrong-date phone; open the same Hospital patient and resident on every device; bring an app back to the front after midnight

Then Every device shows the same timeline; the new entry carries the server's date; every device can sign in

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The tester compares screenshots across devices (3.8 'Test with one device set to the wrong date'). The time-zone device is Q4

Where it ran: dev; test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
